svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two sills: RHS 100 x 50 x 3, 2,750 mm, standing 100 mm tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sill centres 600 mm apart: outside width 650 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six crossbars SHS 50 x 50 x 3, 550 mm, between the sills,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tops flush with the sill tops. Centres from the pump end:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pump end: weld a 3 mm cap over each sill end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Joint end: a 10 mm plate 150 x 170 mm on each sill end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flush with the sill bottom, 50 mm out each side; four

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 mm holes 50 mm each side of the sill centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 25 and 145 mm up from the bottom of the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two plates clamped to the drive module's plates.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld on a flat table, diagonals equal within 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pedestals (DWG-103) and cleats (DWG-104) weld on after.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the frame sits flat; no rock on a level floor.
